limitations: one Hansen tile, geographically restricted eastern belt, tiny sample and spatial autocorrelation
complete sparse-patch package is queryable only within retained patches; not a seamless production AOI
engine runtime and dependencies excluded symmetrically; script bytes disclosed separately
oracle knows measured compression outcomes, cannot be called deployment performance
no legal/source accuracy inference or 17-plot generalization claim

measurement_scope.decode: one full decode; three window repetitions each of five 32x32 windows; handles recreated; OS cache uncontrolled
measurement_scope.encode: one wall/CPU sample; arrays preloaded; validation, checksums, buffered writes; no fsync
measurement_scope.geotiff_integrity: TIFF control lacks engine per-stream SHA verification; file hashes verified outside timings
measurement_scope.query: raster window reads, not polygon semantics or supplier compliance
measurement_scope.selector_cost: feature extraction and tree walk at ingestion, no selector invocation required at query time
measurement_scope.source_read: bounded windows; source strips decompress wider than requested; excluded from codec encode
